newsitem.title: USA: Strawbridge stake lifted by Farallon group.
newsitem.headline: Strawbridge stake lifted by Farallon group.

text.p: A group led by Farallon Capital Management LLC said Monday it raised its stake in Strawbridge & Clothier to 1,821,300 common shares or 17.1 percent from 14 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 328,700 common shares between Oct 22 and Oct 31 at prices ranging from $16.875 to $20.25 per share.
The company operates 13 department stores at its original location in Philadelphia and in the surrounding Delaware Valley area of Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Delaware.
Under the Clover name, it operates 26 discount stores in the same market area as well as in the Lehigh Valley area of Pennsylvania.
